content:
Maya L: Heads up 8am PT9: Received invoice from Vertex Systems (INV-0421) for $8,120. Invoice missing PO number and vendor legal name in header says 'Vertex Sys' which doesn't match Coupa vendor. PDF: https://s3.company/vertex/INV-0421.pdf
Evan B: Probably a small monthly add-on. Which PO would this map to? I search Coupa and see PO 100221 for 'Vertex Systems, LLC' active for May.
Priya M: That PO 100221 covers "support & add-ons" monthly line items. If invoice lines match the contract SOW we can match without reissue. Any attachments showing line-level usage?
Ravi S: PDF shows line for "usage: extra agent seats" 40 seats @ $203/seat = $8,120. PO 100221 has "agent seat" unit pricing but capped at 35 seats. This looks like an overage invoice.
Maya L: Vendor did not reference contract or PO. Should we ask for explicit PO reference? Small amount but policy requires PO match for automated posting.
invoices-bot: New invoice INV-0421 created in NetSuite. Status: "Needs Coding/Approval". Assigned to: finance-approvers.
Evan B: For overage < $10k we can route to manager-level approver if procurement confirms overage terms. Priya, can you confirm contract terms?
Priya M: Contract says vendor will invoice overages at listed unit price and we are responsible for actual seat counts. Procurement confirms we approved up to 35 seats, anything above is billed monthly. So this is legitimate.
Ravi S: Suggest attaching vendor usage report next time. For now i'll code to GL 6540 (SaaS recurring) and tag as "overage".
Maya L: I'll ask vendor to include PO 100221 on a reissued invoice but proceed with routing to manager for approval to avoid delay.
Evan B: Manager approval granted by L2 (approval granted via email). Posting once reissue or confirmation arrives.
Priya M: Noted. Closing loop when NetSuite shows PO reference.
Maya L: Thanks everyone.
